coverage.notes: Per-hunt rows (hunt type x residency x weapon x unit group x season) exactly as NDOW publishes them, 2020-2025. Includes junior, nonresident-guided, landowner damage compensation, PIW, Dream, Silver State and Heritage tags (flagged in note). Nevada has no separate whitetail hunt. 2020: Hunters Afield not published (hunters = null; tag holders in licenses).
Per-hunt rows 2020-2025 as published, incl. antlered/antlerless/spike plus depredation, incentive and private-lands hunts (flagged in note). 2020: Hunters Afield not published.
Per-hunt rows 2020-2025 ('Horns Longer/Shorter Than Ears', junior, damage-comp and special tags). 2020: Hunters Afield not published.

Desert, California and Rocky Mountain bighorn combined; the hunt name says which. Per-hunt rows 2020-2025. Some special tags use 'Any Open Unit' or 'Unit restrictions see CR ...' as the unit, as published.
Per-hunt rows 2020-2025 (units 101-103). Small samples (1-14 tags per hunt).
Nevada's first moose season was 2024; one resident antlered hunt (2 tags) in 2024 and 2025.

Two row types: (1) per-hunt rows from the hunt-data workbooks (one unit group, resident/nonresident, hunters afield, success) 2020-2025; (2) per-unit harvest by sex from the Status Book 'Black Bear Harvest by Unit' tables 2020-2025 (hunters per unit not published). 2025 unit table transcribed from an image table.

Statewide only (single statewide harvest limit; NDOW publishes no unit-level lion harvest). Delivered: 2021-22, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 license years (year = start year). Omitted 2020-21 and 2022-23: the latest edition (2025-2026 Status Book, Table 31) revised those seasons but prints them in a low-resolution image whose bold digits cannot be read with certainty, and earlier editions' figures are superseded (2020-21 also duplicated the 2018-19 row there). Hunters afield not published; licenses = tag sales.
No NDOW turkey harvest report (statewide or by unit) was found on ndow.org for 2020-2025; no rows delivered.
Nevada has no white-tailed deer season.
